name: Stamp impact
visual_intent: A state label (DOWN, EXPIRED, DONE) slams onto the stage with a tilt and a tiny impact squash, announcing a change of state in a diagram or story.
implementation_summary: Fast scale-down from 2.6x with power4.in onto a settled tilt, a 50 ms squash and a back.out recovery; optional four-step x shake of another element (the card that was hit).
runtime_api: Studio.fx.stamp(tl, target, at, {rotate, fromScale, duration, stagger, shake, shakeAmount})

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (settled scale and tilt, shake returns home) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
